readme_excerpt: Bun Documentation   •   Discord   •   Issues   •   Roadmap Read the docs → What is Bun? Bun is an all-in-one toolkit for JavaScript and TypeScript apps. It ships as a single executable called bun. At its core is the Bun runtime, a fast JavaScript runtime designed as a drop-in replacement for Node.js.
